## objectives
* trim nucleotides or amino acids (to add: coding region) if >95% gaps

# Setup
## Libs
```{r, message=F}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools) #mixedsort
library(purrr)
```

## Ins and Outs
```{r}
# Input merged/aligned sequences
f.in.fasta<-paste0("../00_aligned/aligned/")
nuc.fasta.in<-list.files(f.in.fasta,pattern="merged_nuc",full.names=T)%>%mixedsort()
prot.fasta.in<-list.files(f.in.fasta,pattern="merged_prot",full.names=T)%>%mixedsort()

# meta (to check full match with seqs)
f.in.meta<-paste0("../../02_merge/2026-01-08_merged/merged_meta/")
nuc.meta.in<-list.files(f.in.meta,pattern="*merged_meta*",full.names=T)%>%mixedsort()

# Output
today<-Sys.Date()
f.out<-paste0(today,"_trimmed/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

# segment/protein ordering
segments0<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")
segments<-segments0%>%
  mixedsort()
# those rep'd in data
mix<-str_split(nuc.fasta.in, "_|\\.") %>% unlist
#only look at segments that are present in dataset
segments<-segments[which(segments %in% mix)]
l.seg<-length(segments)

prot.ord<-c("PB2","PB1","PB1-F2","PA-X","PA","HA","NP","NA","M1","M2","NEP","NS1")%>%
  mixedsort()
mix.p<-str_split(prot.fasta.in, "_|\\.") %>% unlist
prot.ord<-prot.ord[which(prot.ord %in% mix.p)]
l.prot<-length(prot.ord)

# main outputs
nuc.fasta.out<-str_replace_all(nuc.fasta.in,f.in.fasta,f.out)%>%
  str_replace_all("merged","trim")
prot.fasta.out<-str_replace_all(prot.fasta.in,f.in.fasta,f.out)%>%
  str_replace_all("merged","trim")

# logfile
text.out<-paste0(f.out,today,"_logfile.txt")
cat(paste0("Run date: ",today),file=text.out,sep="\n",append=F)
```

## Main loop
```{r}
#TRIM GAPERS (end trim only)
#ability to make per-seg diffs to get different final widths
min.nuc_end_byseg<-c(
 "PB2"=0.1,
 "PB1"=0.1,
 "PA"=0.1,
 "HA"=0.1,
 "NP"=0.1,
 "NA"=0.1,
 "M"=0.1,
 "NS"=0.1
)

#exclude rows with >90% gaps from anchor calc only (denominator is conserv)
row_gap_max_calc<-0.90 

# optional internal trim 
#keep if gap fraction (gaps per width) <= max.gap_internal; NULL to disable
max.gap_internal<-0.99

## Read nuc fasta
nuc<-map(nuc.fasta.in,readDNAStringSet)

## Log initial widths
tot0<-c()
for(i in 1:l.seg){
 ww<-width(nuc[[i]][1])
 cat(paste0("Segment ",segments[i],", initial align width = ",ww),file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)
 tot0<-c(tot0,ww)
}
cat(paste0("Total initial genome width = ",sum(tot0)),file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

## Trim (end-only) + write outputs + metrics
metrics<-tibble()

for(i in 1:l.seg){
 print(paste0("Trimming nucleotides for ",segments[i]))

 seg<-segments[i]
 nm0<-names(nuc[[i]])
 width.i<-width(nuc[[i]][1])
 nseq<-length(nuc[[i]])
 #make nuc a matrix to calc gaps
 mat<-as.matrix(nuc[[i]])

 gap_frac_row<-rowMeans(mat=="-")
 use_row<-gap_frac_row<=row_gap_max_calc #is it too gappy?
 n_excl<-sum(!use_row)
 if(sum(use_row)<10){
  stop(paste0("Too few sequences after temporary gap filter for ",seg))
 }
 # ambiguous counts as present; only "-" is gap
 cov<-colMeans(mat[use_row,,drop=FALSE]!="-")
 thr<-min.nuc_end_byseg[seg]
 #find positions that are good as end trim anchors based on having >95% nucs (5% -) 
 #within anchors is a contiguous region considered separately for gap threshold (diff underlying mechanisms, indels, seq diffs)
 good<-cov>=thr
 if(!any(good)){
  stop(paste0("No end-trim anchors found for ",seg," at thr=",thr,"; lower min.nuc_end for this segment"))
 }

 first<-min(which(good))
 last<-max(which(good))
 keep_pos<-seq.int(first,last)
 #keep positions onlyyy
 mat2<-mat[,keep_pos,drop=FALSE]
 
 # optional: internal trim after end trim
  if(!is.null(max.gap_internal)){
   gap_frac_col<-colMeans(mat2=="-")
   #keep columns with gap fraction less than the max gap of 90-95% (above)
   keep_col<-gap_frac_col<=max.gap_internal
   if(!any(keep_col)){
    stop(paste0("No columns kept after internal gap trim for ",seg,"; relax max.gap_internal"))
   }
   mat2<-mat2[,keep_col,drop=FALSE]
  }

 nuc[[i]]<-DNAStringSet(apply(mat2,1,paste0,collapse=""))
 names(nuc[[i]])<-nm0

 width.f<-ncol(mat2)
 rm<-width.i-width.f

 print(paste0("  width ",width.i," -> ",width.f," (removed ",rm,")",
              "; thr=",thr,
              "; temp_excl_rows=",n_excl))

 cat(paste0("Segment ",seg,", final align width = ",width.f,", removed = ",rm," columns"),file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

 metrics<-bind_rows(metrics,tibble(
  segment=seg,
  n_seqs=nseq,
  aln_len_in=width.i,
  aln_len_out=width.f,
  cols_removed=rm,
  frac_cols_removed=rm/width.i,
  min.nuc_end=thr,
  row_gap_max_calc=row_gap_max_calc,
  temp_excl_rows=n_excl
 ))
}

cat(paste0("Total final genome width = ",sum(metrics$aln_len_out)),file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

## Export trimmed fasta
walk2(nuc,nuc.fasta.out,function(x,f){
 writeXStringSet(x,filepath=f,format="fasta")
})

## Export metrics csv
write_csv(metrics,paste0(f.out,today,"_trim_metrics.csv"))
```

nuc.meta<-replicate(n=l.seg, vector())

#read and print matchiness
for(i in 1:l.seg){
  nuc.meta[[i]]<-read.csv(nuc.meta.in[i])
  all(names(nuc[[i]]) %in% nuc.meta[[i]]$seq_new) %>% print
}

# Protein sequences
## read in prot seqs, trim gaps, export
```{r}
prot<-replicate(n=l.prot,vector())

## Read protein data + log initial widths
tot0<-c()
for(i in 1:l.prot){
 print(paste0("Reading protein data for ",prot.ord[i]))
 prot[[i]]<-readAAStringSet(prot.fasta.in[i])
 ww<-width(prot[[i]][1])
 cat(paste0("Protein ",prot.ord[i],", initial align width = ",ww),
     file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)
 tot0<-c(tot0,ww)
}
cat(paste0("Total initial proteome width = ",sum(tot0)),
    file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

## Params (protein)
min.aa_end_byprot<-setNames(rep(0.1,l.prot),prot.ord) #end anchors on non-gap coverage
row_gap_max_calc_aa<-0.90 #exclude rows with >90% gaps from denominator (remove in clean align)

# optional internal trim (keep if gap fraction <= max.gap_internal_aa); set NULL to disable
# max.gap_internal_aa<-NULL
max.gap_internal_aa<-0.99

## TRIM GAPERS (end trim + optional internal gap trim; no per-seq letter loop)
metrics.prot<-tibble()

for(i in 1:l.prot){
 print(paste0("Trimming amino acids for ",prot.ord[i]))

 protname<-prot.ord[i]
 nm0<-names(prot[[i]])
 width.i<-width(prot[[i]][1])
 nseq<-length(prot[[i]])

 mat<-as.matrix(prot[[i]])

 # temporarily exclude ultra-gappy rows from coverage calculation only
 gap_frac_row<-rowMeans(mat=="-")
 use_row<-gap_frac_row<=row_gap_max_calc_aa
 n_excl<-sum(!use_row)
 if(sum(use_row)<10){
  stop(paste0("Too few sequences after temporary gap filter for ",protname))
 }

 cov<-colMeans(mat[use_row,,drop=FALSE]!="-")
 thr<-min.aa_end_byprot[protname]

 good<-cov>=thr
 if(!any(good)){
  stop(paste0("No end-trim anchors found for ",protname," at thr=",thr,"; lower min.aa_end for this protein"))
 }

 first<-min(which(good))
 last<-max(which(good))
 keep_pos<-seq.int(first,last)
 mat2<-mat[,keep_pos,drop=FALSE]

 # optional internal gap trim after end trim
 if(!is.null(max.gap_internal_aa)){
  gap_frac_col<-colMeans(mat2=="-")
  keep_col<-gap_frac_col<=max.gap_internal_aa
  if(!any(keep_col)){
   stop(paste0("No columns kept after internal gap trim for ",protname,"; relax max.gap_internal_aa"))
  }
  mat2<-mat2[,keep_col,drop=FALSE]
 }

 prot[[i]]<-AAStringSet(apply(mat2,1,paste0,collapse=""))
 names(prot[[i]])<-nm0

 width.f<-ncol(mat2)
 rm<-width.i-width.f

 print(paste0("  width ",width.i," -> ",width.f," (removed ",rm,")",
              "; thr=",thr,
              "; temp_excl_rows=",n_excl))

 cat(paste0("Protein ",protname,", final align width = ",width.f,", removed = ",rm," columns"),
     file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

 metrics.prot<-bind_rows(metrics.prot,tibble(
  protein=protname,
  n_seqs=nseq,
  aln_len_in=width.i,
  aln_len_out=width.f,
  cols_removed=rm,
  frac_cols_removed=rm/width.i,
  min.aa_end=thr,
  row_gap_max_calc=row_gap_max_calc_aa,
  temp_excl_rows=n_excl,
  max.gap_internal=max.gap_internal_aa
 ))
}

## write trimmed aligns + log final widths
tot<-c()
for(i in 1:l.prot){
 Biostrings::writeXStringSet(prot[[i]],prot.fasta.out[i])
 ww<-width(prot[[i]][1])
 cat(paste0("Protein ",prot.ord[i],", trimmed amino acid align width = ",ww),
     file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)
 tot<-c(tot,ww)
}
cat(paste0("Total trimmed proteome width = ",sum(tot)),
    file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)

## export protein trim metrics
write_csv(metrics.prot,paste0(f.out,today,"_trim_metrics_prot.csv"))

```
